meta.metric: XBI-excess (ret - XBI over identical T-30..T-7 window)

clean_methods.screen: drop rows with entry_px<2 AND adv_usd<1e6 (note: does NOT catch reverse-split names like RNAZ)

multiple_testing.note: 7 buckets x 2 metrics (raw+excess) = up to 14 tests; ~0.7 false positives expected at a=0.05. Judge excess t only after BH/Bonferroni.
